sheets.title: Offline reset beside a sealed vault — 390 × 844, touch
sheets.caption: Beside a sealed vault, taken offline, then Erase. Before, the tab stayed on /vault with the reset panel open. Its writes were halted and its memory still offered the erased vault. After, the tab always leaves for a fresh document. The front door shows what was left first, above the roads in, with two keys: erase again, or dismiss.
sheets.before: stays on /vault · panel 168×127 @53,358 · the erased vault still offered
sheets.after: lands on /OpenSesame/ · notice 324×127 @33,78, above the roads (@33,310) · rows 294×20 @48,92 and @48,118 · keys 44×44 @48,147 and @100,147
